title: One more from me... a retro creature collector that somehow became a full game
author: Defiant-Diet-485
selftext:
[https://remix619.itch.io/telford-tales](https://remix619.itch.io/telford-tales)

We're on like version 63 now or something and felt like it's now worth sharing the project.

  
This is a complete game with questing, fighting, collecting and travelling all the way to and beyond an actual ending, if you can stick it out to get that far. There's lot's to do.

I am not a game developer, but I am a game player, and persistant on steering an idea towards what I experience as another easily accessible and addictive gameplay loop. 

Another vibe coded experiment gone well in my opinion. I say that because in posting it here, I hope to be corrected to get a feel for what could improve the player facing experience. For example, if being nowhere at all near England makes the experience too unrelateable? Are there elements that are too questionable to know whats happening? Does anything look to alien to deserve to appear?

Fans of the old retro Pokemon game style will recognise it easily, this drawing direct inspiration from such, contaminated with odd britishness and actual rough as you like real world locations with low levels of dignity.

Again, very free to play in your browser on mobile or desktop. 

It has been heavily AI assisted and subjected to a stupid amount of tweaking, rewriting and testing from all angles because I don't know when to leave things alone.
